function: Learns RIS discrete phase-shift configurations (GFlowNet conditioned on a channel chart of the receiver position) that maximize the downlink rate at the central subcarrier (p. 1-3).
system: Downlink OFDM, single-antenna transmitter and receiver, blocked direct link, passive reflecting RIS (3x3 to 8x8, 1-4 bit phases); 2.5 GHz, 20 MHz, 16 subcarriers (p. 2, 4).
method: GFlowNet with MLP policies (4 hidden layers of 64), trained label-free from a rate reward with the trajectory balance loss, conditioned on an Isomap channel chart (p. 2-4).
data_channel: DeepMIMO 'Indoor 1' scenario (synthetic dataset), RIS on ceiling, receiver on two grids, fixed transmitter, 16 subcarriers; chart calibrated with 3000 channels (p. 1, 4).
test_conditions: Trained on channel samples and tested on test channels of the same Indoor 1 scenario; results per RIS size (3x3 to 8x8) and phase bits (p. 4-5).
baselines: PPO deep RL (actor and critic MLPs, 3 hidden layers of 64), random RIS control, exhaustive-search optimum for 3x3 RIS, continuous-phase ideal case (p. 4-5).
metrics: Downlink rate normalized by the optimum (average normalized rate), spectral efficiency for Top-k candidates, continuity and trustworthiness of the channel chart (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "DeepMIMO datatset [22]." - scenario Indoor 1 of the DeepMIMO dataset is the channel source for training and testing (typo of the paper kept in the quote).
q2_support: p. 4: "for a set of receiver test channels." - held-out channels of the same Indoor 1 scenario; the paper states no test on an unseen scenario, band, grid or array.
q3_support: p. 4: "We compare our approach with the Proximal Policy" - PPO deep RL on the same task; p. 4: "We further add the performance of a random" - random RIS control; both on the normalized rate.
q4_support: p. 4: "Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) architecture with 4 hidden layers" - only the architecture is given; no parameter count, operations, runtime or complexity order of the proposed method (orders on p. 2 are for heuristics and [18]).
q5_support: p. 4: "DeepMIMO datatset [22]." - trains and tests on the public DeepMIMO channel dataset; the paper gives no link to its own code.
notes: Single-antenna link but with a RIS, so the system check passes. GFlowNet (MLP) learns the RIS phase vector: area 3. Channel chart is built by Isomap (p. 3), not learned by the GFlowNet. The cost of the proposed method is never reported: p. 2 gives O(2^(nu N)) for heuristic search and O(N) for [18]. Fig. 3 on p. 4 checked as image.
